how_tos.How to Apply for Yatra SBI Credit Card O:
You can apply for a Yatra SBI Credit Card online through the official SBI website.
You can also apply for the card through Bankbazaar.com or apply by following these steps:
Visit the Bankbazaar.com website
Select the option of "Credit Card"
Choose SBI Cards
Click on "Yatra SBI Card" and select the "Check Eligibility" tab
Fill in the required details to check if you are eligible for the card
If you meet eligibility criteria, you can view the online application page
Click on "Submit" after filling out the application form
Upload the required KYC documents so that your application is completed
You will receive an Application ID as soon as your card application is completed.
You can track the application status of your Yatra SBI card with the Application ID.

reward_point_benefits: Reward points on every Rs. 100 spent on all categories.

fees_and_charges.Cash advance fee:
- 2.5% of the amount withdrawn under Rs.500 (Domestic ATMs)
- 2.5% of the amount withdrawn or Rs.500 (International ATMs)
fees_and_charges.Payment due date fee: 2% of the payment amount; minimum of Rs.150
fees_and_charges.Statement request: Rs.100 per statement (more than 2 months old)
fees_and_charges.Late payment:
- From Rs.0-Rs.500: Rs.100
- More than Rs.500 up to Rs.1,000: Rs.250
- More than Rs.1,000 up to Rs.5,000: Rs.750
- More than Rs.5,000 up to Rs.25,000: Rs.950
- More than Rs.25,000 up to Rs.50,000: Rs.1,100
- More than Rs.50,000: Rs.1,300
fees_and_charges.Over limit fee: 2.5% of the over limit amount; minimum of Rs.500

miscellaneous: State Bank of India charges Rs.100 to Rs.500 for replacement of lost or damaged cards.
